historical_record.description: At residents' request the Recreation and Park Commission named the softball field at Parkside Playground in memory of Bob Cheney, a longtime Parkside resident who had founded the Parkside softball tournament about 25 years earlier.
On the recommendation of Commissioner Coldwell, who had consulted the neighborhood, the Board of Park Commissioners named the park on Vicente Street between 26th and 28th Avenues Parkside Square.
